title: fix: cmd_attest in CLI never calls C_Initialize or C_Finalize
description:
In src/cli/wp11_cli.c, cmd_attest calls wp11_piv_attest_slot() directly without calling C_Initialize(NULL) first and C_Finalize(NULL) after. Other CLI commands (cmd_list_tokens, cmd_list_keys, cmd_list_mechanisms) correctly bracket all PKCS#11 access with initialize/finalize.

Bad behavior: cmd_attest will fail with CKR_CRYPTOKI_NOT_INITIALIZED or access uninitialized global state, depending on whether another command ran first in the same process invocation.

Fix: Add C_Initialize(NULL) at the start of cmd_attest and C_Finalize(NULL) on all return paths, mirroring the pattern in cmd_list_keys.
